4. Fixed adjacent transparent sidelites which are supported by opaque sill and wall construction of at least 18 inches (457 mm) above the ground, floor or equivalent surface immediately adjacent.

5. Display windows in any establishment, building or structure which fall within the definition of a sidelite if the top of the supporting sill and wall construction is not less than 18 inches (457 mm) above the ground, floor or equivalent surface immediately adjacent and the interior area is occupied with merchandise or similar displays to clearly indicate to the public that it is not a means of ingress or egress.

6. Opaque door pulls or push bars extending across at least two-thirds of the total width of the glazed area.
